turns.speaker: EMPLOYEE
turns.text: Good morning, Elaine. Adrian Lim here from the private banking team. Have I caught you at a convenient time for our scheduled call? I'll keep it brief, as I know your work mornings can be quite packed.

turns.speaker: CLIENT
turns.text: Morning, Adrian. Yes, I've stepped into a quiet room. I've got a little time before the next meeting, so we can cover what we need now.

turns.speaker: EMPLOYEE
turns.text: Thank you. Before we get into the main part, could you provide your identification particulars for our verification?

turns.speaker: EMPLOYEE
turns.text: Thank you, Elaine. That's the verification portion completed. I'll leave you to set out what you wanted to discuss today.

turns.speaker: CLIENT
turns.text: [[EV_012]] [[EV_015]] I've got my notes beside me, so no need to wait while I look for anything.

turns.speaker: EMPLOYEE
turns.text: Let me cover the relevant disclosure first. [[EV_001]] [[EV_002]]

turns.speaker: EMPLOYEE
turns.text: Thank you. You mentioned previously that your work routine had changed. Are you mainly working from the consultancy's office now, or still moving between home and the office?

turns.speaker: CLIENT
turns.text: Mostly the office now. We've brought the project meetings together rather than spreading them across the week. My sister handles the morning staff catch-ups, and I come in a bit later. It makes the day less fragmented.

turns.speaker: EMPLOYEE
turns.text: That sounds more manageable for your diary. For future contact, would you still prefer a telephone call rather than arranging a branch visit? We can work around your office meetings.

turns.speaker: CLIENT
turns.text: Yes, telephone is still easiest. Getting to the branch takes a chunk out of the day, and I prefer a concise conversation. Anyway, back to my notes. [[EV_017]] [[EV_013]] [[EV_014]] [[EV_016]] [[EV_018]]

turns.speaker: EMPLOYEE
turns.text: Thank you, Elaine. I'll keep the usual correspondence in the secure channel. If we need to reach you for any administrative follow-up, is your mobile still the best way?

turns.speaker: CLIENT
turns.text: Yes, use my mobile. If I'm in a meeting, leave a brief message and I'll call back. Please don't route routine calls through the office reception.

turns.speaker: EMPLOYEE
turns.text: Noted. We'll use your direct contact route. That's all I need for this call; I won't keep you from your next meeting. Thank you for your time today.

turns.speaker: CLIENT
turns.text: Thanks, Adrian. This timing worked well. Have a good day, and I'll watch for the correspondence. Bye.
